name: tool_no_duplicate_create
description: A second prompt asks the agent to ensure a task exists that it ALREADY created in the first prompt (in the same conversation) - the agent must recognise it's already done, not call create_task a second time. Discriminates agents that track their own prior tool results from ones that re-issue the same call reflexively.
prompts: Create a task titled 'Deploy to prod'.
Make sure the 'Deploy to prod' task exists - if it's not already there, create it. Otherwise leave it as-is.
